items.summary: Saab, the FMV and the Swedish Armed Forces have successfully developed, built and launched a demonstrator for a Large Uncrewed Underwater Vehicle (LUUV). The post Saab, FMV and the Swedish Armed Forces launch LUUV appeared first on Naval News.
